subject: CI cache idea for monorepo-turbo
body:
Hey — saw issue #412 on monorepo-turbo about CI cache misses on large monorepos. We've been building a hosted cache layer aimed at exactly that build-graph-aware invalidation problem.

No pitch here, just curious if that's still an open pain point for the project or if you've already solved it — happy to share notes either way.
note: This is a DRAFT. No email address was found for this lead, so this text is meant to be posted as a GitHub issue/discussion comment by a human — not sent automatically. Nothing in this repo posts to GitHub on your behalf.
